## My Members » Search Members » Sorting Options


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000103852


## Sorting Options


The sorting options enable organizing the member results table based on various attributes.


### Sort Name A-Z


Arranges members in alphabetical order by name.


### Sort Name Z-A


Arranges members in reverse alphabetical order.


### Sort ID Highest


Displays members by descending order of their ID numbers.


### Sort ID Lowest


Displays members by ascending order of their ID numbers.


### Sort Newest First


Displays the most recently joined members first.


### Sort Oldest First


Displays the longest-standing members first.


### Sort Most Revenue


Sorts members based on the highest revenue generated.


### Sort Least Revenue


Sorts members based on the lowest revenue generated.


### Sort Most Credits


Displays members with the highest credit balance first.


### Sort Least Credits


Displays members with the lowest credit balance first.


### Sort Most Likes


Sorts members based on the number of likes received.


### Sort Least Likes


Displays members with the fewest likes.


### Sort Most Views


Sorts members based on the highest number of profile views.


### Sort Least Views


Displays members with the lowest number of profile views.
